main_quests.name: New Arrival
main_quests.description: Arrive at the troubled town, speak with the local elder, and prepare for your first venture into the nearby graveyard.

objectives.description: Speak with Elder Rowan to understand the threat.

time_events.description: The stranger leaves to scout — temporarily unavailable.

main_quests.notes: Time events live at quest TOP level (not inside unlocks_on_complete). Tests the delayed-flag mechanic.

main_quests.name: Clearing the Threat
main_quests.description: Venture into the Graveyard and eliminate the encroaching undead to secure the perimeter.

objectives.description: Defeat 20 zombies in the Graveyard (play the Cemetery stage).

main_quests.notes: REVISED from ghoul x10: ghoul is a miniboss that never spawns in current wave tables. Zombies spawn from 0:00 in stage_graveyard.

main_quests.name: 旧墓的秘密
main_quests.description: The grave digger knows what lies beneath the cemetery. Earn his trust and learn the hidden dark secret.

objectives.description: Speak with the Grave Digger at the Cemetery.

main_quests.notes: REVISED from reach_location 'Crypt': crypt is locked behind graveyard_warning, which THIS quest awards — the original was a circular deadlock. The grave digger is at cemetery (unlocked after mq_02). His warning is what opens the crypt.

main_quests.name: 返回营地
main_quests.description: Return to town and report the crypt's secret to Elder Rowan to unlock passage to the outer woods.
main_quests.notes: Chapter 2 gate. Region unlock currently sets flags + regionUnlocks; town swipe gating is future work.

main_quests.name: 森林边缘
main_quests.description: Push past the safety of the town into the overgrown perimeter of the Forest and clear the undead pressing at the edge.

objectives.description: Clear out 15 skeletons (they press at the forest edge from 2:00 in the Graveyard stage).

main_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally forest_wolf x15 — no forest enemies exist yet. Re-point to forest_wolf when forest content lands.

main_quests.name: 深处的呼唤
main_quests.description: Follow the mysterious echoes deep into the canopy and reach the Deep Woods.

objectives.description: Reach the Deep Woods location in the Forest region.

main_quests.notes: deep_woods is unlocked by default, so this is walkable immediately after chapter 2 opens.

main_quests.name: 古老的威胁
main_quests.description: Confront the ancient evil that commands the dead — slay the Necromancer in the deepest trial.

objectives.description: Defeat Lilith the Necromancer (extended Graveyard stage boss).

main_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally treant_boss (doesn't exist). Boss kill_count works — death events carry enemyData.id for bosses.

main_quests.name: 森林之心
main_quests.description: Survive the full extended trial to stabilize the region's mana flows.

objectives.description: Complete the extended Graveyard stage (10-minute trial).

main_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally deep_woods_core stage (doesn't exist). Objective uses the canonical `target` field — `stage_id` is also accepted as an alias.

main_quests.name: 暗影降临
main_quests.description: The dead grow restless across every region. Destroy the shadow host pouring from the graves.

objectives.description: Defeat 20 ghosts (they spawn from 2:30 in Graveyard stages).

main_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally shadow_fiend x20 (doesn't exist). Ghosts are the closest existing stand-in.

main_quests.name: 最后的防线
main_quests.description: Rally all allied forces for the ultimate defensive stand — hold the line through the final trial.

objectives.description: Complete the extended Graveyard stage one final time.

main_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally final_siege stage (doesn't exist). Re-point when cross-region stages land.

side_quests.name: Herbalist Request
side_quests.description: The herbalist's garden at the forest's edge is overrun by rats. Clear them so her remedies can be crafted.

objectives.description: Defeat 10 rats (they spawn from 1:30 in Graveyard stages).

side_quests.notes: REVISED from collect_item 'rare_root' x3: no item/pickup system emits collect_item yet. Rat-clearing keeps the herbalist theme and is completable today.

side_quests.name: 守卫的训练
side_quests.description: Assist the guards with combat sparring in the crypt to test advanced area suppression techniques.

objectives.description: Complete the extended Graveyard stage training run (crypt opens after the Grave Digger's warning).

side_quests.notes: REVISED: stage id was 'graveyard_extended' (actual: stage_graveyard_extended); dropped the unused numeric tier field.

side_quests.name: 猎人的挑战
side_quests.description: Prove your tracking skills alongside the local survivalist by hunting down the forest's brutes.

objectives.description: Hunt down 10 brutes (they spawn from 3:00 in the extended stage).

side_quests.notes: PLACEHOLDER: originally alpha_stalker x5 (doesn't exist). Re-point to alpha_stalker when forest enemies land.

_schema._note: Gate rules are AUTO-DERIVED from unlocks_on_complete at load time (QuestSystem._buildDerivedGates) — content listed here becomes available when this quest completes. content_gates.json holds only non-quest overrides and temp-disable rules.

main_quests[].name: string — display name

objectives[].target: string — content ID to target (canonical; complete_stage also accepts stage_id as an alias)
objectives[].tier: string — stage tier (optional, not enforced yet)

main_quests[].prerequisites[]: string — flag names required to see this quest

time_events[].flag: string — flag to set when timer fires

main_quests[].notes: string — design/test notes (ignored by the engine; safe to keep)

_schema.side_quests[]: same schema as main_quests but placed in the side_quests array (array placement determines type)
